In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], a '''battle''' was fought over the planet [[Valahari/Legends|Valahari]]. After the Valahari refused to stop selling advanced engines to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the Republic established a blockade of the planet. Refusing to acknowledge the blockade, the planet's [[Viscount (title)/Legends|Viscount]] [[Harko Vane]] tried to break through with a convoy of freighters. The Jedi in charge of the blockade, [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] did not want to resort to using the force, but Vane's freighter exploded in what looked like a Republic attack. In reality, his ship had been sabotaged by the CIS. Vane's death prompted his escort to open fire on the Republic forces, and after a brief fight, the battle ended. The Republic retained the blockade; however, the Valahari, believing the Republic responsible for Vane's death, joined the Confederacy and destroyed the blockade days later.
